_comment: Source of truth for skill-trigger evals. Run `python3 tools/claude_blue.py evals` to regenerate evals/<case>/case.yaml. Each positive case names the skill that should fire and the profile (tag) whose plugin contains it; negative cases must not invoke any Claude-Blue skill. `also` lists other skills that are an equally correct choice for the prompt.

positive.prompt: An EDR alert says 'Suspicious PowerShell download cradle' on host FIN-WS-044 for user j.martin at 09:12 UTC. Walk me through triaging it: what do I check first, and how do I decide true vs. false positive?
A user reported an email asking them to re-validate their Microsoft 365 password via a link. How should the SOC triage this report and decide on purge and block actions?
I have EDR process events as CSV and CloudTrail JSON for the same incident. Help me merge them into a single UTC timeline so I can see the order of events.
We wrote a new Sigma rule for LSASS memory access. How do we test it with Atomic Red Team and recorded datasets before enabling it in production?
GitHub secret scanning told us an AWS access key AKIA... was pushed to a public repo an hour ago. What do we do right now and how do we scope what the key did?
One of our users got around 30 Okta Verify push notifications overnight and approved one by accident. How do we detect this pattern and respond?
Review our GitHub Actions setup: we use pull_request_target to run tests on forks and our actions are referenced by tags like @v4. Is this safe?
Our auditors want a proper information security risk register. Help me set one up with likelihood, impact, owners and treatment decisions.
Design a SOAR playbook for reported phishing emails that enriches the URLs, decides a verdict and purges the message from all mailboxes. I want it to fail safely.
Management wants the EDR to isolate hosts automatically when ransomware behaviour is detected, without waiting for an analyst. What guardrails should we put in place?

Our SOC wants to run a two-day purple team exercise with our internal red team to check whether we detect credential access and lateral movement on Windows. Help me plan it: objectives, procedure list, roles and how we record results.
We ran 30 Atomic Red Team tests yesterday and exported all alerts from Sentinel. How do I work out which tests were detected, which were missed and how fast the alerts came?
Build me an nftables host firewall for an Ubuntu web server that only allows SSH from our admin subnet and HTTPS from anywhere, and make sure I can't lock myself out when applying it.
Give me a hardened sshd configuration for our Linux servers with modern key exchange algorithms, and tell me how to test that weak clients are rejected.
